title: Your best friend needs one tiny favour
scenario: Your best friend’s account asks you to help recover their social profile by sending them a code that just arrived on your phone. Their messages sound normal and reference a joke from last week.

answers.A: Send it because the private joke proves it is really your friend.
answers.B: Do not send the code; contact your friend another way and check what the code says it is for.
answers.C: Ask your friend to call or video you before doing anything with the code.

explanation: Compromised accounts include old chats, photos and context. Private history can be read by whoever took the account.
proTip: Inside jokes are not two-factor authentication.
